nodes.description: Public token name string storage slot, set in constructor to CuteBullCoin.
Public token symbol string storage slot, set in constructor to CBC.
Public uint8 decimals storage slot, set in constructor to 18.
Public uint256 total supply storage slot representing the minted token amount.
Internal mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of each holder.
Internal nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, total supply and minting the supply to msg.sender.
Public view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Public view returning the balance of a given tokenOwner address.
Public view returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
Public function transferring tokens from msg.sender to recipient using SafeMath.
Public function moving tokens from a third party using SafeMath balance and allowance updates.
Pure SafeMath addition helper with overflow require.
Pure SafeMath subtraction helper with underflow require.
Pure SafeMath multiplication helper with overflow require.
Pure SafeMath division helper with division-by-zero require.
Attacker-controlled caller identity used as token owner, spender and mint recipient.
Address parameter granting spend approval in approve.
Token amount parameter stored directly into allowed before safe checks.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer used in safeSub/safeAdd.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are debited.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in safeSub and safeAdd.
Address parameter queried in balanceOf.
Owner address parameter queried in allowance.
Spender address parameter queried in allowance.
Named return local holding balances[tokenOwner] in balanceOf.
Named return local holding allowed[tokenOwner][spender] in allowance.
Unchecked state write allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens performed by an unprivileged caller.
State write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) mutating balance based on user supplied tokens.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(...) crediting an arbitrary recipient address.
State write balances[from] = safeSub(...) debiting a third-party account over which caller has only allowance rights.
State write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...) reducing allowance without prior explicit check.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(...) crediting an arbitrary recipient address.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply value.
Constructor initializes balances[msg.sender] with the full supply.
msg.sender is used as the unchecked mint recipient in the constructor.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in a raw subtraction.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
balanceOf uses the tokenOwner parameter as mapping key.
allowance reads from the nested allowed mapping.
allowance uses tokenOwner parameter as first key.
allowance uses spender parameter as second key.
approve writes into the allowed mapping for the caller.
approve derives the allowance owner directly from msg.sender.
approve consumes the spender parameter.
approve consumes the tokens parameter without validation.
approve performs an unguarded state write on the allowed mapping.
The approve write operation mutates the allowed state variable.
transfer invokes safeSub to compute the sender balance reduction.
transfer invokes safeAdd to compute the recipient balance increase.
transfer rewrites the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer debits the account of msg.sender without any additional authorization.
transfer uses the to parameter as recipient.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as amount.
transfer performs the sender balance subtraction state write.
transfer performs the recipient balance addition state write.
The sender debit write mutates the balances state variable.
The recipient credit write mutates the balances state variable.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom rewrites the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom rewrites the allowed mapping for the caller.
transferFrom treats msg.sender as the authorized spender without explicit allowance gating logic.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as debit source.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as credit destination.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as amount.
transferFrom performs the from-account balance subtraction state write.
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction state write.
transferFrom performs the recipient balance addition state write.
The from-account debit write mutates the balances state variable.
The allowance write mutates the allowed state variable.
The recipient credit write mutates the balances state variable.
